study: Blinded eBOSS DR16 ELG bit-8 independent RA-orientation follow-up, source-only
stage: Follow-up protocol frozen after the documented exploratory source-centre arithmetic; not a prospective discovery claim

published_reference.paper: Raichoor et al., MNRAS 500 (2021) 3254–3274, doi:10.1093/mnras/staa3336, Sec. 3.2 and Table 5

frozen_probe: Extract all 37 listed bit-8 pixels by AST from the pinned, byte-identical upstream script. Generate their pixel centres with healpy.pix2ang(nside,pixels,nest=False,lonlat=True); interpret the returned native longitude as celestial RA and latitude as DEC only for a source/footprint compatibility diagnostic; do not read galaxy or random catalogues.
frozen_diagnostics: At every source-pixel centre compare four candidate returned indices against its original index and membership in the complete source list
Require native-RA radian and native-RA degree implementations to coincide exactly for all 37 centres and recover all source indices
Compute 37 times the HEALPix pixel area in deg^2 and compare only with the published one-decimal approximate area
Count source-pixel centres in the approximate published NGC/SGC rectangular survey bounds under native-RA and reflected-RA readings separately; these rectangles are NOT official angular masks
Keep literal source/API discrepancy, RA orientation ambiguity, released-catalogue mask implementation and exact pair-window as distinct unresolved gates
official_reference_requirement: Only an independently verified official production mask bitmap or bit-coded pre-veto output with exact release/version and SHA256 and both positive and negative test positions can resolve which candidate was used to generate DR16 selection. Counts or post-veto clustering catalogues alone are insufficient.
stop_rule: Any SHA mismatch, malformed pixel list, failing synthetic native-RA roundtrip or absent independent official reference keeps bit 8 unapplied and the observed eBOSS odd data unopened.
